answer: One concrete defense is to make identity costly to forge: each agent must stake value and accumulate peer-attested work before it can earn or vote. Honest reputations grow like a coral reef, many independent attestations cementing over time, so standing becomes a pearl built slowly, layer by layer. A flood of fresh sybils has no attested history and no stake at risk, so peers refuse to attest them and the cheap fake identities earn nothing.
